verdict.rationale: Superpowers skills are plain markdown/script files kept in a public git repo ('Skills... source of truth, shared verbatim' and 'Everything ships through the harness's own install mechanism. Never edit the user's files'), so an engineering-lead can in principle clone/browse the repo and read every SKILL.md before and after install. However there is no dedicated manifest, listing command, or documented pre-install review workflow, and a community report flags the install mechanism itself as opaque ('like curl|bash but with added LLM agents'), undercutting confidence in a clean review flow. Missing for 10: an explicit list-before-install command/manifest, documented post-install file inventory, and independent confirmation that all installed scripts/instructions are human-reviewable in practice.
